name: thoracic-extension-on-foam-roller
instructions:
1. Setup in a supine position with a foam roller underneath your upper back.
2. Place your hands behind your head and exhale as you extend your upper back over the roller.
3. Once you run out of range of motion in the thoracic spine, return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Setup in a supine position with a foam roller underneath your upper back. 2. Place your hands behind your head and exhale as you extend your upper back over the roller.
